pages.quiz:
BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #1
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Types of Business Ownership is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Types of Business Ownership as rumours only.
   B. Explain Types of Business Ownership with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Types of Business Ownership never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Types of Business Ownership.

2. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Littering in markets
   B. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   C. Avoiding all community work
   D. Destroying road signs

3. Which statement about Marketing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Marketing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Marketing as rumours only.
   C. Say Marketing never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Marketing.

4. Which statement about Trial Balance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trial Balance.
   B. Say Trial Balance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Trial Balance as rumours only.
   D. Explain Trial Balance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

5. Which statement about Methods of Price Determination is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Methods of Price Determination.
   B. Treat Methods of Price Determination as rumours only.
   C. Explain Methods of Price Determination with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Methods of Price Determination never happens in Kenya.

6. Which statement about Public Finance is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Public Finance.
   B. Say Public Finance never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Public Finance with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Public Finance as rumours only.

7. Which statement about Cash Books is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Cash Books.
   B. Say Cash Books never happens in Kenya.
   C. Explain Cash Books with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Cash Books as rumours only.

8. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore prices in shops
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Avoid saving forever
   D. Hide all money underground

9. Which statement about Procurement is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Procurement as rumours only.
   B. Say Procurement never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Procurement.
   D. Explain Procurement with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. Which statement about Savings and Investments is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Savings and Investments never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Savings and Investments as rumours only.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Savings and Investments.
   D. Explain Savings and Investments with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Measure rainfall only
   C. Name the president
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

12. Which statement about Entrepreneurship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Entrepreneurship never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship as rumours only.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Savings and Investments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Financial Markets and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer and Investor Protection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
